note: Tiled dungeon on the binary (Boroczky) tiling, the same one the 2011 server used. `room` is the prototype drawn in EVERY cell; `critters` is a library of character art keyed by NAME, each piece given in generic cell-local coordinates so it can be placed in any cell. Which cell gets which character is not stored -- the demo hashes the cell's address with a salt drawn at page load, so one reload fixes an infinite dungeon. Room numbers are likewise generated from the cell coordinates.
